rules: Studio files only. Pick the entry with the highest `from` <= the file's parts_db_version (oldest entry when unknown). Render `target` (default: the part id) at placement ∘ transform. Parts without an entry use studio:<id> when the library has it, else the id. `partId` (default: the part id) is the LDraw part number for parts lists; `alias` entries name a Studio id that is another LDraw part, and hold whatever LDraw has under the Studio id.
